instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Open an iPhone in my terminal." It reads the row with do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:govijr-terminal-phone"}.

2. It checks that git, an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 15 or later, and Xcode 26 or later are on your computer, and if terminal-phone is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/govijr/terminal-phone.git ; cd terminal-phone ; bash scripts/build-phone.sh ; ./dist/terminal-phone self install.
3. It runs the row's command: terminal-phone
4. Read what it shows you. The site you asked through runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.
